svg.title: How to use idstack: skills mapped to ADDIE and backward design
svg.desc: A guide to idstack in four parts. One: add the plugin, open your course folder, type /idstack:start. Two: the eight pipeline skills in sequence with their ADDIE phase and backward design stage: needs-analysis (Analyze, Stage 1), learning-objectives (Design, Stage 1), assessment-design (Design, Stage 2), course-builder (Develop, Stage 3), course-quality-review, accessibility-review and red-team (Evaluate before launch, alignment check), course-export (Implement). Three: four skills for any time: quick-check, storyboard, question-bank, evaluation-plan. Four: shortcuts for an existing course, for short SAM cycles, and for plain-language requests.
